units: <cite ref="Megillah 7b:12">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>מַכְשִׁירֵי אוכל נפש</he> acts preliminary to the preparation of food (as grinding the slaughtering knife &c.).
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>הוא ולא מַכְשִׁירָיו</he> it says (<cite ref="Exodus 12:16">Ex. XII, 16</cite>) ‘that’ (alone may be done), but not its preliminaries.
<cite ref="Exodus 12:16">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ שאפשר וכ׳</he> acts which might have been done a day before.
<cite ref="Eruvin 102b:16">Erub. 102ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>מ׳ מצוה</he> requirements of a religious act (to be performed on the Sabbath, v. <cite ref="D00397"><he>דָּחָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 136a">Sabb. 136ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="M01181"><he>מ׳ מילה</he></cite> requirements for circumcision.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 5:1">Tosef. Pes. V, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:1:10">Y. Sabb. XIX, 17ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.

senses.gloss: Makhshirin (things which make an object fit for levitical uncleanness), name of a treatise of the Mishnah and Tosefta, of the Order of Tohăroth.
